response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity IS NULL, avg_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, quantity_rank FROM ranked WHERE quantity_rank <= 3

assumptions.assumption: Non-NULL invoiced quantities contain numeric text. A zero derived_total_cost makes the ratio undefined, so that ratio is excluded from its average.
